sourceFormat: Raw workflow declaration with dependencies empty until the public CLI walkthrough inserts the one newly packed operations app.
authorityBoundary: Budget delegation establishes prospective operating eligibility. Sam’s selected deployment and specific authorization must be recorded separately on the exact accepted assessment run hash. No software identity authentication or actual dispatch occurs.
timeBoundary: Same calendar date only; overnight periods, DST transitions and real-time scheduling require another profile.
staffingBoundary: One simplified qualification pool, stable available count over the full declared absence, no other simultaneous staffing commitments.
